subject: general
question: As per the Multidimensional Poverty Index Progress Report 2023, which of the following states registered the steepest decline in the number of MPI poor?
solution:
The correct answer is **Uttar Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** registered the steepest decline in the number of MPI poor as per the Multidimensional Poverty Index Progress Report 2023.
 
• The **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)** measures poverty based on various deprivations experienced by people in their daily lives, including health, education, and standard of living.
 
• The report highlights significant improvements in reducing poverty across several states in India.
 
• Uttar Pradesh's efforts in improving access to basic services and economic opportunities have contributed to this decline.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)** is an international measure of acute poverty. It complements traditional income-based poverty measures by considering various deprivations that people face in their daily lives. The MPI assesses poverty at the individual level, with a focus on three main dimensions:

 
 

 Dimension
 Indicators
 
 
 
 

 Health
 Nutrition, Child Mortality
 
 

 Education
 Years of Schooling, School Attendance
 
 

 Standard of Living
 Cooking Fuel, Sanitation, Drinking Water, Electricity, Housing, Assets
